title: Consolidate HTML entity tables into a single spec-generated source (#2645)
issueTitle: Bug report: Malformed and mis-mapped entries in the To HTML Entity byteToEntity table
why: The report says To HTML Entity turns the character ⇌ (U+21CC) into the malformed "⇌;" when it should be "⇌", so the whole Output box text tells the buggy and fixed builds apart.
